name: stash-mobile
description: Capacitor shells that ship the Stash web client (web/) as native iOS and Android apps

scripts.init: npm run build && cap add ios && cap add android && npm run overlays && cap sync
scripts.sync: npm run build && npm run overlays && cap sync
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
